mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (at 0.09%) is at a historically low level, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.5% signals a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% monthly and FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, it signals persistent inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized and UNRATE < 4.5%), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when the late-cycle expansion regime is active and CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A INDPRO below 105.0 signals a contraction in industrial production that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) at 140045.0 thousand is above the 135000.0 threshold, which signals strong labor market conditions that compress risk premiums and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 135000.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 1000.0 and residential sales (RSAFS) are below 400000.0, it signals a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0 AND RSAFS < 400000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL monthly change above 0.3% signals accelerating inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%.
